name: 23113 · Midlothian, VA
findings: ZIP 23113 (Midlothian) has 122 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23113 (Midlothian) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 14 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
